what: All nine parity-*.test.ts suites executed against both backends through the portable createServer. Supersedes the session-map smoke that backed local-facade_parity-cb0cb69.

antiGaming.stubTransportRemoved: wasm construct() returns a real WasmWebTransport over a reserved live session; the previous { close(){} } cast is gone
antiGaming.getStatsBackedByTraffic: bytesSent and bytesReceived asserted > 0 after echo (wasm-server-session-parity.test.ts)
antiGaming.streamCapsBehavioralOnWasm: waitUntilAvailable stream-capacity test runs on both backends via a limit-configured harness; no soft-skip

wasmExclusions.reason: connect-failure tests need a real unreachable UDP socket; the in-memory relay cannot address a dead peer
toWebTransport / connectWithRetry wrap a native ClientSession with no wasm equivalent
serverCertificateHashes algorithm/digest validation: wasm pins by live hash and never consumes those entries
pooled connects cannot verify this self-signed loopback server (pooling forbids hash pinning; wasm has no insecureSkipVerify). Wasm pooled reuse is covered behaviorally in wasm-parity-helpers.test.ts
